_comment: Round-14: bypasses found by a red-team code review of the parser itself. Two P0s. (1) RUNNER PREFIX — both write-shape classifiers dispatched on argv[0] alone, so one word in front ('nice cp ... hooks/lib.py') defeated every guard SECURITY.md invariant 4 names. The identical attack was already solved for `sf` via wrapped_sf, with its own fixture; the hole five functions away went unexamined, which is why these fixtures exist for the write side too. (2) BRACE EXPANSION — bash expands {a,b} before globbing, and no layer modelled it, so `cat ~/.torq{u,x}e/secret` read the signing secret with plain cat. Plus case-variance on a case-insensitive filesystem (the author's own platform). The allow cases lock in that none of the fixes over-deny ordinary work.
